spss.rowExpression: B1 [COLPCT.COUNT ' %' F40.0, TOTALS[COUNT 'Base Total' F40.0, COLPCT.COUNT 'Base%' COMMA40.0]]
spss.breakExpression: REGION + REGION2 + D3 + BC_BAU8+ GENDER + AGE2 + SEC2 + WEEK
spss.rawCommand:

 /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=B1 EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE

     /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION2 D3 BC_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK ORDER=A KEY=VALUE 
  EMPTY=INCLUDE

/TITLES
TITLE='Marital Status'.

spss.rowExpression: $N_FQ [COLPCT.COUNT ' %' F40.0, TOTALS[COUNT 'Base Total' F40.0, COLPCT.COUNT 'Base%' COMMA40.0]]

rowSets.name: $N_FQ
rowSets.label: N_FQ1. Which of the following flavors of Noodles will you consider buying in your next purchase?

spss.breakExpression: REGION + REGION2 + D3 + N_BAU8 + GENDER + AGE2 + SEC2 + WEEK
spss.rawCommand:
CTABLES
  /VLABELS VARIABLES=$N_FQ REGION REGION2 D3 N_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK DISPLAY=LABEL
  /TABLE $N_FQ [COLPCT.COUNT ' %' F40.0, TOTALS[COUNT 'Base Total' F40.0, COLPCT.COUNT 'Base%' COMMA40.0]] BY REGION  + REGION2 +  D3  + N_BAU8   + GENDER + AGE2  + SEC2  + WEEK 
   /SLABELS POSITION=ROW
   /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=$N_FQ EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
    /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION  ORDER=A KEY=VALUE EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
     /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION2 D3 N_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK ORDER=A KEY=VALUE 
  EMPTY=INCLUDE 
  /CRITERIA CILEVEL=95
/TITLES
    TITLE='N_FQ1. Which of the following flavors of Noodles will you consider buying in your next purchase?'.

spss.rowExpression: $DP [COLPCT.COUNT ' %' F40.0, TOTALS[COUNT 'Base Total' F40.0, COLPCT.COUNT 'Base%' COMMA40.0]]

rowSets.name: $DP

spss.breakExpression: REGION + REGION2 + D3 + WH_BAU8 + GENDER + AGE2 + SEC2 + WEEK
spss.rawCommand:
CTABLES

   /SLABELS POSITION=ROW
 /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=$DP EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
    /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION  ORDER=A KEY=VALUE EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
     /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION2 D3 WH_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK ORDER=A KEY=VALUE 
  EMPTY=INCLUDE  
  /CRITERIA CILEVEL=95
/TITLES
    TITLE='WH_QBI. (It helps the heathly growth of my hair) Now we would like your impressions of some Hair Care Product  brands, whether or not you have tried them yourself'.

rowSets.name: $XP
rowSets.label: ML_BAU5A. Which of these Malt Beverages brands have you ever consumed

spss.breakExpression: REGION + REGION2 + D3 + ML_BAU8 + GENDER + AGE2 + SEC2 + WEEK
spss.rawCommand:
CTABLES
  /VLABELS VARIABLES=$XP REGION REGION2 D3 ML_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK DISPLAY=LABEL
  /TABLE  $XP [COLPCT.COUNT ' %' F40.0, TOTALS[COUNT 'Base Total' F40.0, COLPCT.COUNT 'Base%' COMMA40.0]] BY REGION  + REGION2 +  D3  + ML_BAU8 + GENDER + AGE2  + SEC2  + WEEK  
 /SLABELS POSITION=ROW
 /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=$XP EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
    /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION  ORDER=A KEY=VALUE EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
     /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION2 D3 ML_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK ORDER=A KEY=VALUE 
  EMPTY=INCLUDE  
  /CRITERIA CILEVEL=95
/TITLES
    TITLE='ML_BAU5A. Which of these Malt Beverages brands have you ever consumed'.

spss.rowExpression: $XXXD [COLPCT.COUNT ' %' F40.0, TOTALS[COUNT 'Base Total' F40.0, COLPCT.COUNT 'Base%' COMMA40.0]]

rowSets.name: $XXXD
rowSets.label: ML_QBI. (Perfect for celebration/ during occasion) Your impressions of some Malt Beverages brands, whether or not you have tried them

spss.breakExpression: REGION + REGION2 + D3 + ML_BAU8 + GENDER + AGE2 + SEC2 + WEEK
spss.rawCommand:
CTABLES
  /VLABELS VARIABLES=$XXXD REGION REGION2 D3 ML_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK DISPLAY=LABEL
  /TABLE  $XXXD [COLPCT.COUNT ' %' F40.0, TOTALS[COUNT 'Base Total' F40.0, COLPCT.COUNT 'Base%' COMMA40.0]] BY REGION  + REGION2 +  D3  + ML_BAU8 + GENDER + AGE2  + SEC2  + WEEK  
 /SLABELS POSITION=ROW
 /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=$XXXD EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
    /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION  ORDER=A KEY=VALUE EMPTY=INCLUDE TOTAL=YES LABEL='' POSITION=BEFORE
     /CATEGORIES VARIABLES=REGION2 D3 ML_BAU8 GENDER AGE2 SEC2 WEEK ORDER=A KEY=VALUE 
  EMPTY=INCLUDE  
  /CRITERIA CILEVEL=95
/TITLES
    TITLE='ML_QBI. (Perfect for celebration/ during occasion) Your impressions of some Malt Beverages brands, whether or not you have tried them'.
